api.reason: No patched release exists: the advisory (updated 2026-11-17) marks picomatch <=4.0.7 vulnerable and 4.0.7 is the newest version published (checked 2026-11-18). The ReDoS needs a crafted glob pattern (repeated single-branch extglobs); picomatch here only ever compiles this repository's own patterns, at build, test or watch time. In the gateway it is reached only through devDependencies: jest (jest-haste-map via anymatch, micromatch, and ts-jest via jest-util, all picomatch 2.3.2) and @nestjs/cli / @nestjs/schematics via @angular-devkit/core (picomatch 4.0.4). `npm prune --omit=dev` leaves every copy out of the production image, and no request reaches a glob. Remove this entry when picomatch ships a fix, and bump with the seven-day rule.
